questions.q: What does Milentije say happened to the cat Kiki?
o: Dad ran her over with the car
questions.e: In the video: "Kiki je mrtva. Mama, tata ju je zgazio kolima" — Kiki is dead. Mom, Dad ran her over with the car.

questions.q: What does Rosa suggest buying instead of a cat?
questions.e: In the video: "onda možemo jednog kanarinca, onako finog, malog" — then we could get a canary, a nice little one.

questions.q: Why does Milentije urgently need his mother to move?
o: Mom wants to live with Miša
Nina agreed to return, thinking he no longer lives with Mom
questions.e: In the video: "ubedio sam Ninu da mi se vrati, ali sam joj rekao da više ne živim sa mamom" — I convinced Nina to come back, but I told her I no longer live with Mom.

questions.q: What is Milentije's brother's profession?
questions.e: In the video: "On je plastični hirurg, ali ona njega voli više nego mene" — He is a plastic surgeon, but she loves him more than me.

questions.q: How many cream cakes did Rosa eat?
questions.e: In the video: "Osam krempita si pojela, Roso" — You ate eight cream cakes, Rosa.

questions.q: What do the brothers agree on?
o: Leave Mom at home with the canary
Take Mom to a nursing home and split the cost
questions.e: In the video: "Ostavimo je tamo, platimo dom. Platimo po pola" — We'll leave her there, we'll pay for the home. We'll split it.

questions.q: Why was Milentije not born in a maternity ward?
o: She didn't get there in time
She wanted to watch the last episode of a TV series
questions.e: In the video: "jer je htela da pogleda poslednju epizodu «Otpisanih»" — because she wanted to watch the last episode of "Otpisani".

questions.q: Why does the nursing home manager come at the end?
o: To return Rosa to her family
She is looking for a lost suitcase
questions.e: In the video: "hteli bismo da vam je vratimo" — we would like to return her to you.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word

questions.e: kofer — suitcase; masc.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Ona je vrlo *živahna* žena.
questions.e: živahan — lively; fem.: živahna.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Svi ste me *izneverili*.
questions.e: izneveriti — to let down; past pl.: izneverili.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Nama je stalo da obrazujemo naše *pacijente*.
questions.e: pacijent — patient; acc. pl.: pacijente.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Ja *garanciju* na ludilo ne mogu da dam.
questions.e: garancija — warranty; fem.; acc.: garanciju.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Ona je uvek bila lepo *vaspitana*.
questions.e: vaspitan — well brought up; fem.: vaspitana.

questions.q: Ona je odrasla u tako vrlo ___ atmosferi.
questions.e: after the preposition u — locative fem.: u čudnoj atmosferi.

questions.q: Dok njene drugarice slušaju ___ muziku, ona divlja uz rokenrol.
questions.e: muzika is fem., accusative: klasičnu muziku.

questions.q: Nije htela da ___ poslednju epizodu.
questions.e: after da — present tense, perfective: da propusti.

questions.q: Mi jesmo ___ vašu majku u dom.
questions.e: the subject «mi» (plural) — past plural: primili.

questions.q: Ti bar da znaš koliko ja brinem ___ mami.
questions.e: brinuti o + locative: brinem o mami.

questions.q: Ona ga je ___ i tresla.
questions.e: the subject «ona» — past fem.: duvala.

questions.q: Ona je uvek bila lepo ___.
questions.e: ona — fem.: vaspitana.

questions.q: Hteli bismo da ___ je vratimo.
questions.e: vratiti nekome — dative: vratiti vam.
